proof-narrative-lean-equiv.evidence: [first review 2026-11-21] The statement bounds m(rho) by norm tr_desc + sum_i norm tr_trans(rho, p_i). lean.ref QOU.Torsion.mass_upper_bound_localised resolves to the sibling. It proves, over any seminormed additive commutative group, that hsplit : total = descended + sum transient implies norm total <= norm descended + sum norm transient (norm_add_le, norm_sum_le); it is sorry-free. This is the inequality the statement asserts, with the split as a hypothesis. Not encoded: the split itself (tr(alpha) = tr_desc + sum tr_trans, supplied by the cat-eigenspace and cat-transient lemmas), and the identification m(rho) = norm of tr(alpha). Both are disclosed in the ts scope note, so this is an honest partial formalisation rather than a mismatch. The extra lemma transient_trace_eq_zero_of_global_compat is correct and relevant: under global trace compatibility every transient term vanishes. The module docstring calls the descent map an idempotent, a small slip; it is an involution whose +1 projection is idempotent.
